scope: Development integration of Grok Build as an external live-MCP client; no distributable iteration assigned

checks.detail: Windows x64 Release provider tests, Studio, MCP proxy and Studio live-test harness built with the existing OCCT SDK

checks.name: provider-connectors
checks.detail: Grok Build TOML export, exact executable/endpoint binding, account independence, quoted paths, invalid endpoint/path rejection and environment-placeholder rejection; existing provider completion/replay/team contracts also passed

checks.name: native-connectors-ui

checks.name: existing-studio-live-mcp
checks.detail: Separate synthetic Studio: prepared edit, parametric holes, mesh inspection, temporary save, undo, New and explicit failure after disconnect. This test used the MCP proxy directly, without a Grok model

checks.name: official-grok-build-config-and-doctor
checks.detail: Official Grok 1.0.52 parsed the native export in an isolated Grok home; stdio handshake negotiated MCP 2025-11-25 and discovered 92 ARK tools. Doctor also returned healthy against an intentionally nonexistent Studio endpoint, confirming that it verifies only proxy discovery

checks.name: official-grok-build-acp-initialize
checks.detail: Unauthenticated isolated runtime negotiated protocolVersion 1; advertised auth method grok.com, loadSession true, image false and audio false. No prompt or inference was sent

checks.name: grok-authenticated-live-authoring
checks.detail: Requires the operator's CLI login and eligible account. No Grok inference, model-specific vision, cost receipt or Grok-driven Studio mutation was validated

checks.name: embedded-acp-assistant
checks.detail: This change exports external MCP. ACP session/permission/tool lifecycle is separate from the built-in Responses provider loop

limits: Configuration export and MCP discovery do not establish authenticated inference or live document identity; agent_onboard and doc_info must confirm the selected Studio
